Soil fertility · three-field with a clover third (AD 200 N)

scope: Equilibrium wheat/barley grain per field hectare from the qualified round-2 soil-fertility state (Exhaustion Land and Broadbalk 1926-1967 blind passes; residues scale with the stand below 0.5 t grain) under a three-field rotation at the AD 200 non-fertilizer N input chosen by the user (27.5, middle of the 20-35 band). Factor F = Y_land / (0.68 x A0). The Han North China Plain keeps its AD 2 census fit with no nutrient transfer (water-limited), and bare three-field improves the 11-region census fit (output/fertility_integration_20261106/earth_census.json); the clover third is a sensitivity. Rothamsted soil everywhere; Hargreaves PET x 0.625. Rural food needs stay fixed at the earlier baseline. The same resulting grain flows constrain residents and available institutional reach sources. Not a census, famine or sovereignty prediction.
